locations.note: Polina's story: the Wehrmacht enters Stalingrad in August 1942, her father is executed and she becomes a sniper.
Operation Tonga, June 1944: Kingsley drops with the Parachute Regiment, helps destroy the Merville Gun Battery and meets Richard Webb.
June 1942: Wade Jackson and his gunner Hernandez fly a Dauntless in the Battle of Midway and destroy two Japanese carriers.
November 1943: shot down and captured on Bougainville, Jackson is freed by the 93rd Infantry Division and flies a captured Aichi dive bomber to help retake the island.
Lucas Riggs of the Rats of Tobruk, August 1941: a failed ambush on an Afrika Korps convoy and the defence of the port.
April 1945: Vanguard hijacks a train to Hamburg and boards a U-boat for the files on Project Phoenix.
October 1942: Riggs disobeys Major Hamms at the Second Battle of El Alamein and retakes a hill on his own.
Captured, the team is taken to the Gestapo headquarters in Berlin, where Richter interrogates them; the frame story of the whole campaign.
Jackson is caught trying to steal a plane at Tempelhof; in the finale Vanguard chases Freisinger to the airfield, kills him and takes his plane.

routes.name: Task Force Vanguard
routes.note: Vanguard hijacks a train to Hamburg's U-boat pens, is captured and taken to Gestapo headquarters in Berlin, then breaks out as the city falls and runs Freisinger down at Tempelhof.

routes.name: Pvt. Lucas Riggs
routes.note: From the besieged Rats of Tobruk in 1941 to the hill Riggs retakes against orders at El Alamein.

routes.name: Lt. Wade Jackson
routes.note: From the dive-bombing runs at Midway in 1942 to the jungle of Bougainville, where Jackson is shot down in 1943.
